title: Incident Operations
description: Incident queue, status transitions and OSPF endpoint evidence.

panels.title: Incidents
panels.description: Shows incidents active across the selected window and recently resolved incidents. Enter an incident ID to look up any recorded incident.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT incident_id::text AS "Incident ID", device_name AS "Device", severity AS "Severity",
       status AS "Operator status", event_count AS "Events", first_seen AS "First seen", last_seen AS "Last seen",
       status_changed_at AS "Status changed", ospf_scope AS "OSPF scope", ospf_link AS "OSPF link",
       technical_recovered_at AS "OSPF recovery confirmed", superseded_at AS "Superseded"
FROM grafana_incidents
WHERE (${incident:sqlstring} <> '__networksec_all__' AND incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring})
   OR (${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' AND superseded_at IS NULL
       AND first_seen < to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0)
       AND (status <> 'resolved' OR status_changed_at >= to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0)))
ORDER BY status = 'resolved', last_seen DESC, incident_id
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Status history
panels.description: Enter an incident ID to see when and how its status changed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT changed_at AS "Time", previous_status AS "Previous status", status AS "Status", source AS "Source"
FROM grafana_incident_history
WHERE ${incident:sqlstring} <> '__networksec_all__' AND incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}
ORDER BY change_id DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: OSPF endpoint evidence
panels.description: Latest reliable neighbor state by endpoint and last observation time. An empty link indicates an unmapped peer. Enter an OSPF incident ID to show evidence for its configured link.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scope AS "Scope", link_id AS "Link", area AS "Area",
       device_name AS "Reporter", interface_name AS "Interface",
       local_router_id AS "Local router ID", peer_router_id AS "Peer router ID",
       neighbor_state AS "Neighbor state", last_observed_at AS "Last observed"
FROM grafana_ospf_endpoints AS endpoint
WHERE ${incident:sqlstring} = '__networksec_all__' OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM grafana_incidents AS selected
    WHERE selected.incident_id = ${incident:sqlstring}
      AND selected.ospf_scope = endpoint.scope AND selected.ospf_link = endpoint.link_id
)
ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, scope, link_id, local_router_id, peer_router_id
LIMIT 500
